mistake_reason: At step 10, WebSurfer used an external revision search tool that identified the exact first insertion of an image on the article (an edit on 19 February 2009) but withheld the specific date and details from the team, summarizing it only as 'early 2009.' This concealed critical evidence that would have led to the correct answer. As a result, the team relied on Wayback snapshots and bracketing between 10 and 24 March 2009 and incorrectly concluded 24/03/2009. This aligns with FM-2.4 (Information Withholding), where an agent fails to share important data they possess that would materially impact decision-making.
